recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a single-file browser game titled "Ashfall Marine: Memory Salvage" from this brief: Create a deterministic creative remix in a post-apocalyptic style, centered on a space marine, but make it emotional. Preserve the core playable mechanic loop while rebuilding the theme, identity, surface art, world language, and presentation around this new premise.

Build a mobile-first idle bouncer management game. Active memory cores bounce around a canvas, rebound off the screen edges, generate Hope Signal once per second based on their income value, and give a small tap bonus plus movement impulse when touched. A timed four-item Supply Cache sells weighted random cores. Purchases spend Hope Signal and either spawn active cores or store them if capacity is full. Squad Memories lets the player deploy or store cores. Ruined Zones provide a purchasable +15% boost. Letters Home records unlocked cores. Preserve save/load, pause/resume, reset, modal UI, blocked feedback, and mobile actionability. Use procedural ash-waste backgrounds and helmet-like memory-core art rather than stock scenes.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: mobile-first idle collection / bouncer management game
- objective: buy bouncing units, keep them active or stored, earn passive score each second, tap units for a small bonus, unlock higher-value units and a boosted region.
- input model: pointer/touch taps on canvas units plus native button taps for shop, inventory, regions, archive, save, pause, reset, deploy, store, buy, and equip.
- core loop: active units bounce inside the canvas, each active unit generates income once per second, the player spends accumulated currency in a timed four-item shop, and inventory/region UI manages deployment and income boosts.
- fail/friction state: insufficient currency triggers blocked feedback; active capacity stores overflow purchases; pause and reset are modal states rather than loss states.

## Protected Mechanics
- Preserve bouncing canvas units, wall rebound, per-second passive income, tap-on-unit bonus and impulse, timed restock, weighted random shop, buy/spend economy, inventory deploy/store, capacity cap, region boost, save/load, pause/resume, and reset semantics.

## Rebuild Premise
Ashfall Marine: Memory Salvage reframes the units as emotional memory cores orbiting the last space marine in a ruined colony. Hope Signal replaces money, Supply Cache replaces shop, Squad Memories replaces inventory, Ruined Zones replaces maps, and Letters Home replaces the collection archive while mechanics remain the same.
